entities.name: Panama Canal Workers and Diaspora
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Thousands of Barbadians ('Bajans') migrated to work on the Panama Canal construction (1904–1914) and other large infrastructure projects across the Caribbean and Central America, creating a significant diaspora and remittance economy.
